description: Legion DAW AI Agent — MCP tool matrix registered with google-agents-cli

tools.name: query_neural_core
tools.description: Retrieves relevant context from the Legion LanceDB memory bank (384D vectors). REQUIRED before architectural changes.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads any file on C: or D: drives. Inspect code, configs, audio metadata, logs.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Lists files and folders in a directory on C: or D:.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes content to a file. WRITE RESTRICTED TO C:\ ONLY.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Executes a shell command. Destructive commands blocked by Iron Gate.

tools.name: ingest_cortex_data
tools.description: Triggers high-speed cortex ingestion inside Docker Reactor for GPU vectorization.

tools.name: extract_cortex_data
tools.description: Triggers cortex extraction inside Docker Reactor.

tools.name: generate_music_track
tools.description: Generates audio using local Gemma 4 GPU weights — phonetic descriptors or MIDI structures.

tools.name: get_asset_grid
tools.description: Returns snapshot of latest ingested audio assets from DuckDB (sonic_core_v2.duckdb, 1082 assets).

tools.name: get_artist_dna
tools.description: Retrieves Artist DNA signature benchmark for ADAMSCARMCCOY. Used to audit generated tracks.

tools.name: analyze_audio_file
tools.description: Deep audio analysis — BPM, key, energy, spectral profile — on any local audio file.

tools.name: relay_tuning_instructions
tools.description: Logs tuning feedback and match scores back into the LanceDB memory after generation audits.

tools.name: extract_stems
tools.description: Separates audio into stems (drums, bass, vocals, melody) using local Demucs.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Semantic vector search across the 2010-embedding LanceDB audio_vibe_gpu table.

tools.name: get_track_dna
tools.description: Returns full DNA profile for a specific track — BPM, key, tags, embedding signature.

tools.name: get_tuning_report
tools.description: Returns the latest sovereign tuning report comparing generated output vs Artist DNA target.

tools.name: pipeline_health_summary
tools.description: Live status of DuckDB (1082 assets), LanceDB (2010 vectors), and GPU engine.

tools.name: get_data_atlas
tools.description: BPM distribution, top keys, and asset composition breakdown across the full library.

tools.name: analyze_library_trends
tools.description: Statistical trend analysis across the full indexed audio library.

tools.name: export_data_for_cloud
tools.description: Exports structured data package for upload to GCP legiondaw-87798. Returns Tailscale stream URL.

tools.name: create_analysis_notebook
tools.description: Generates a Jupyter notebook for deep audio analysis and ML experimentation.

tools.name: check_ingestion_status
tools.description: Checks current state of the cortex ingestion pipeline.

tools.name: clear_vram_bloat
tools.description: Clears GPU VRAM cache on the local NVIDIA GTX 1650 Super to reclaim memory.
